question: What are URA Case Summary Reports and what is their purpose?
answer: The URA Case Summary Reports (hosted at https://ura.go.ug/download-category/case-summery-reports/) provide curated, authoritative digests of precedent rulings and judgments rendered by the Tax Appeals Tribunal (TAT), the High Court of Uganda (Commercial Division), Court of Appeal, and Supreme Court. Published on a quarterly and bi-annual schedule, these digests educate taxpayers, legal practitioners, and tax consultants on judicial statutory interpretation, burden of proof in tax assessments, input tax credit verification, customs valuation, transfer pricing, and penal enforcement.

question: What is URA Case Digest Volume XI (Jul – Dec 2025) and what decisions does it cover?
answer: Published on April 13, 2026 (13 MB, 1 file, 588 downloads), URA Case Digest Volume XI covers thirty-eight (38) landmark judicial decisions delivered between July and December 2025 across domestic taxes, customs, and criminal tax fraud. Key legal topics addressed include corporate tax residency under Section 14 ITA, EFRIS electronic invoicing compliance mandates under Section 24 VAT Act, statutory 30% tax deposits under Section 15 TAT Act, digital services tax (DST) liabilities for non-resident suppliers, and cross-border transfer pricing adjustments. The full publication is available for download at https://ura.go.ug/storage/2026/04/The-URA-Case-Digest-Volume-XI.pdf.

question: What is Case Digest Vol. VIII (Jan – Mar 2024) and what are its key highlights?
answer: Published on April 30, 2024 (12 MB, 1 file, 1,757 downloads at https://ura.go.ug/en/download/case-digest-vol-iii-2024/), Case Digest Volume VIII synthesizes tax dispute decisions delivered during the third quarter of FY 2023/24. Key precedents cover: 1) Value Added Tax input deductions where suppliers failed to remit output tax; 2) Section 24 TPCA objection timelines and procedural regularity; 3) Validity of agency notices issued under Section 43 TPCA; 4) Customs tariff reclassifications under the Common External Tariff (CET); 5) Employment benefit taxation and PAYE withholding disputes.

question: What is URA Case Digest July – Sept 2023 (Volume VI Version 4)?
answer: Published on November 1, 2023 (6 MB, 838 downloads, direct PDF https://ura.go.ug/storage/2023/11/Case-Digest-Volume-VI-version-4.pdf), Case Digest Volume VI Version 4 covers decisions from the first quarter of FY 2023/24. It details judicial rulings on withholding tax applicability to technical and management service fees paid to non-resident entities, permanent establishment determinations under bilateral double taxation agreements, interest penalty waivers, and the scope of Section 66 TPCA voluntary disclosure immunity.

question: What is URA Case Digest April – June 2023 (Volume V Version 3)?
answer: Published on October 30, 2023 and updated November 1, 2023 (4 MB, 626 downloads, direct PDF https://ura.go.ug/storage/2023/10/10722_Case_Digest_Volume_V_Version_3.pdf), Case Digest Volume V Version 3 compiles second quarter 2023 decisions from the High Court and TAT. Prominent rulings cover: 1) Deductibility of bad debts under Section 24 Income Tax Act; 2) Stamp duty exemptions on intra-group restructuring under the Stamp Duty Act 2014; 3) Customs seizure of transit consignments diverging from designated routes under Section 210 EACCMA; 4) Burden of proof on taxpayers in commercial documentation audits.

question: What are URA Case Digest Oct – Dec 2022 and earlier editions (Vol I 2022, July-Sept 2022, Jan-March 2023)?
answer: The earlier Case Digest editions (published August 1, 2023 / updated October 2023) establish foundational jurisprudence: 1) Oct-Dec 2022 (2.60 MB, 410 downloads): Focuses on alternative dispute resolution (ADR) settlements and Section 219 EACCMA compounding of customs offences; 2) July-Sept 2022 (5.38 MB): Covers landmark rulings on deemed VAT, tax clearance certificate refusals, and advance tax on commercial transport; 3) Jan-March 2023 (2.24 MB): Covers TAT rulings on bank garnishee enforcement and director liability for unremitted PAYE; 4) Vol I 2022 (6.33 MB, 395 downloads): Comprehensive compendium of foundational High Court Commercial Division and TAT tax judgments.

question: What is the Compendium of EAC Tax Cases?
answer: Published on August 1, 2023 (1.67 MB, 655 downloads at https://ura.go.ug/en/download/compendium-eac-tax-cases/), the Compendium of EAC Tax Cases compiles landmark tax rulings from across East African Community Partner States (Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda). It provides comparative regional jurisprudence on the EAC Common External Tariff (CET), rules of origin verification, post-clearance audits under EACCMA 2004, Single Customs Territory (SCT) revenue transfers, and cross-border transfer pricing within the EAC common market.

question: How can taxpayers and legal practitioners use URA Case Summary Reports in dispute resolution?
answer: Taxpayers and advocates can utilize URA Case Summary Reports to: 1) Evaluate the legal strength of proposed objections before filing under Section 24 TPCA; 2) Cite binding judicial precedents in TAT review applications and High Court appeals; 3) Structure commercial contracts, cross-border technical services, and intercompany transactions in alignment with settled tax jurisprudence; 4) Assess likelihood of penalty reversal or waiver during ADR negotiations.
